name: Sliced Frame Slideshow
description: Full-height image slideshow where each photo sits in a sized frame and is covered and uncovered by staggered sliding slices, with arrow buttons and numbered pagination.
contents: Image frames in wide, tall or square sizes, each with its own slice count
behavior: Slices slide in to cover the current image, then slide away to reveal the next
Navigation is blocked while a transition runs
Slice direction and axis are configurable
Arrows wrap around at both ends
editableByProps: Slides, images, frame sizes and slice counts
Slice direction, orientation, duration, stagger and easing
Arrows and pagination visibility, section height, button labels

needsCodeEdit.change: Change arrow glyphs or button shape
needsCodeEdit.where: Previous slide and next slide buttons in the showArrows block

fixed: Frames use viewport-based sizes with a 280px minimum
